title: Standard kit and expected features
summary: Reviews discuss whether the F70’s standard equipment feels generous or whether expected basic features are missing, but many excerpts are too brief or comparative to show clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the amount of standard kit or say the standard offering is good.

negative.summary: Negative reviews criticize missing features or basic equipment that buyers expected to be included as standard.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined excerpts mention what is or is not standard, often by comparison with other cars or prior models, without enough context to confirm clear approval or dissatisfaction.

limitations: Many sampled excerpts are short references to what is standard and do not provide enough context for a clear sentiment reading.
One positive-assigned example discusses stitching quality in a way that appears inconsistent with the topic label, so the sample may include some noisy fragment assignments.
The topic includes both standard equipment on the F70 and comparisons with previous cars or rival models, which limits how tightly the comments can be summarized as one single aspect.
